name: Santa Marina
positioning: Santa Marina, a Luxury Collection Resort, Mykonos: a hillside resort built like a Mykonian village on a private peninsula of Ornos Bay, with its own sandy beach
best_for: Travelers who want a calm, sandy private beach on Mykonos
Groups and families wanting a villa with its own pool and butler service
Couples looking for a sea-view suite and a spa

facts.text: Santa Marina sits on the private peninsula of Ornos Bay with its own sandy beach.
The resort is designed like a traditional Mykonian village on a slope leading down to the sea.
The private beach is a curve of golden sand in a quiet cove that slopes gradually into clear, shallow water.
Ornos Bay is largely shielded from the strong Cycladic winds.
The property is still owned by the local family that opened it.
The grounds still have the original windmill and a whitewashed chapel.
Interiors are by Greek interior designer Silvina Macipe Krontiras, with light tones and natural island accents of wood and raffia.
Suites have sea views from a balcony or terrace furnished with outdoor dining and sun loungers.
Ginkgo Spa has a traditional hammam, a sauna and a relaxation area.
The infinity-edge Elais Pool has a nearby heated whirlpool and is suited to children.
The resort offers speedboats by the hour for exploring beaches and nearby islands.
Elais serves Greek cuisine with Mediterranean influences.

highlights.text: Santa Marina has its own private stretch of sandy beach on Ornos Bay.
The Oasis Pool is a seawater infinity pool with private cabanas set in the water.
The resort's villas each include a fully equipped kitchen, a swimming pool and butler service.
Ginkgo Spa treatments use natural skincare and thalassotherapy from ESPA and 111SKIN.
Santa Marina is home to the world's first Buddha-Bar Beach.

considerations.text: There are elevators and ramps to most areas, but the hillside grounds still have many stairs and hills.
The beachfront restaurant becomes a lively bar at night, so rooms near the spa are quieter.
The Oasis Pool is exclusively for adults.
